plain_text:
Burlington Fire Commission Meeting  
Friday November 13, 2026 08:31-08:32 
Members Present: Chair Jake Perskinson (via Zoom), Vice Chair Kevin McLaughlin, Monica 
Chapman, and Ashley Bond (via Zoom), and Administrative Assistant Meghan Sweeney.  
Call to Order –  
The meeting called to order at 08:31 am. 
 
Grievance Presentation-  
Meeting summary generated by AI 
The Burlington Fire Commission held a meeting on November 13th to consider award 
nominations. Commissioner Perkinson moved to approve the slate of recommended awards, 
which was motioned by Commission McLaughlin, seconded by Commissioner Chapman and 
Commission Bond resulting in nominations approved by all commission members present. The 
commission confirmed that almost all members would attend the awards ceremony scheduled for 
the 17th. Jake also mentioned he would follow up with Anthony Arapino regarding an attorney 
opinion that had received confirmation from the commission.  
 
Adjournment-  
Motion to adjourn made by Commissioner McLaughlin and seconded by Commissioner 
Chapman at 08:32.
